note: Every day's key verse (blockquote) is the Bíblia Livre para o Mundo (porbrbsl, the ebible mirror's por_bpm USFM) copied by script, replacing the English edition's BSB text; the citation drops '(BSB)'. A row is 'mined' only when the translator reported it verbatim AND the block holds at least 45 characters (or the whole verse) of that verse's Bíblia Livre wording, quote marks aside; partial, nested-quote-adjusted or re-worded quotations are 'self_rendered'.

Where the Bíblia Livre's wording differs from the BSB the English teaches from, the verse is kept and the chapter's own sentences carry the point: 1 John 4:10 'propiciação' (atoning sacrifice), James 1:17 'Pai das luzes' (no 'heavenly'), 1 John 3:1 lacks 'And that is what we are!' (the day quotes 1 John 3:2 'agora somos filhos de Deus'), Psalm 27:14 has no word for 'courageous', 2 Corinthians 5:17 'todas as coisas se tornaram novas', John 14:16 'Consolador' for 'Advocate'. The introduction's parents' note and the book's About/Q&A name the Bíblia Livre instead of the BSB.

AI-translated (job #3592) by fan-out over 8 translators against one pinned brief (titles, labels, register: reader você, prayers tu); tag sequence identical to the English per chapter; awaiting native review.
